body-sm.purpose: Card meta, comparisons, shares, Subcategory rows, captions.

label.purpose: Nav group headings, table headers, count badge, Account pill. Sentence case.

wordmark.purpose: "Purse" in ink at 700, "graph" in Indigo Ink at 600, beside the mark.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Every card (.panel, the drill-down) and the pressed theme-switch segment. Cards carry no border in light.

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Card lift in dark: deeper shadow plus a 3% white hairline ring.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Overlays: the phone More sheet, the account popover and the Account filter list.

shadows.name: control
shadows.purpose: Buttons, form fields, selects, the Account filter and the period stepper. Ghost and text buttons drop it.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focusable element, set once on :focus-visible.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Chevron rotation (.2s) and the phone More and Filter sheets' slide up (.25s). HTMX swaps themselves are instant.

motion.name: donut-sweep
motion.purpose: The donut's single entrance; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No movement, state kept: charts render final, chevron flips, sheets appear (at most a 120ms opacity fade), loading line static at 50%, the loading dim still applies. Scrolling is always instant.

motion.name: busy-line
motion.purpose: The 2px Household Indigo line sliding along the top of a region whose swap is still running after 300ms; static, full width, at 50% under prefers-reduced-motion. Swaps finishing within 300ms show nothing.

themes.chartRetheme: theme.js dispatches a themechange event on document (also on prefers-color-scheme change while System is active); dashboard.js rebuilds ECharts options from getComputedStyle custom properties and calls setOption(..., { notMerge: true }), also on resize. ECharts 5.6 has no live setTheme.
themes.noFlash: Blocking inline script in base.html <head>, before the stylesheet, applies localStorage 'theme' (light|dark|system, else system) to data-theme before first paint; <html> ships data-theme="system".

dataColour.awaiting: awaiting grey plus 45deg hatch; donut decal rgba(255,255,255,.45)
dataColour.incomeSubcategories: the Income Category's hue (Money in bars, Sankey income nodes)
dataColour.moneyOut: muted (a neutral; spending as a whole is no Category)
dataColour.awaitingLine: dashed awaiting grey (a line can't carry the hatch)

charts.style: Classic axes (#64, variant A): legend top-left, quiet axes, axis tooltips as tables, a table beside every chart
charts.legend: top-left, 8px circle icons, ink-2 Inter 500 12px, 16px gap, scrolls; inactive line-strong
charts.valueAxis: whole euros (Intl sl-SI EUR, maximumFractionDigits 0), muted 12px; solid line gridlines; no axis line or ticks
charts.categoryAxis: line-strong baseline, no ticks, muted 12px labels
charts.tooltip: card fill, line border, 10px radius, pop shadow, ink 13px; axis tooltip = table sorted biggest first with a Total row; cents in amounts; Net signed
charts.emphasis: focus series; blur lines to .15, bar segments to .25
charts.cashflow: grouped bars: Money in = Income hue darkened to 3:1 on card (WCAG 1.4.11), Money out = muted, max 22px, 4px top radius, 10% gap; Net = 2px ink line, 7px points ringed in card; under a Member filter, To/from other Members = dashed ink-2 line
charts.trends: 2px lines in Category hue, points on hover only; Awaiting review dashed
charts.perMember: horizontal stacked bars per Bucket, max 28px, Bucket names ink 13px 600, 1.5px card-coloured segment borders, Awaiting hatched; a Category netting to a Refund draws below zero
charts.sankey: nodes 12px wide, 2px radius, 10px gap; links gradient at .3 (.6 on hover, adjacency focus); income labels left, Household top, the rest right, 'name amount' (11px and Household name only when narrow); overlapping labels hidden; each income node in its own Income Category's hue, Household ink-2, Left over / Spent beyond money in / others muted, Awaiting hatched
charts.aria: aria.enabled on every chart, its description the chart element's translated aria-label

completeness.source: Coverage, derived and read-only; only the Accounts the filters include; Accounts with no Statements never count
completeness.monthStates: Complete | Partial (a Gap in it) | Partly tracked (before some included Account's first Coverage day, not all) | In progress (running month, no Gap) | Not tracked (before every included Account's first Coverage day)
completeness.periodState: first of Partial, Partly tracked, In progress, Not tracked, Complete among its months; wholly Not tracked = empty state
completeness.headerLine: between view bar and stat tiles; ink-2 13px, muted 16px info icon, no fill/border/alert colour; 'Incomplete: no Statements yet from <Account> for <range>' (Accounts link to Import, >2 collapse to 'and N more') · '<Account> is tracked from <date>' (no link) · '<amount> (<share>) still awaiting review' (links to Review queue); absent when neither applies
completeness.monthAxisBands: Partial / Partly tracked / In progress: full-height band in Hover (a bar series on hidden axes; Trends uses boundaryGap true), muted 500 11px top label 'Partial' / 'Partly tracked' / 'So far', breaking to the band's width; months in a row in one state form one band, labelled once; a band too narrow for its label's longest word (about 6px a letter) goes unlabelled; running month axis label 'Oct (so far)'
completeness.tooltip: opens with the reason: a muted 12px line under the tooltip head, max 260px, wrapping
completeness.notTracked: month keeps its axis slot, Faint axis label (the only Faint), data null (no bar; lines break); tooltip is the head and 'No Statements yet'
completeness.tables: headers 'Jul (partial)' / 'Jan (partly tracked)' / 'Oct (so far)', the qualifier a block under the month in Muted 400 12px (never widens the table); Not tracked labels and cells Muted 400 (not Faint: text stands 4.5:1), '—' in cells, never 0
completeness.statTiles: comparison becomes 'Not comparable: <Month> is incomplete' when either side isn't Complete
completeness.drillDown: title qualifier '(partial)' / '(partly tracked)' / '(so far)' in Muted 400
completeness.stepper: previous disabled at the period holding the Household's first Coverage day (filter-independent); typed earlier URLs still render, as Not tracked
completeness.notTrackedCard: replaces a wholly Not tracked view: centred panel, 32px 20px padding (24px 16px on phones), 12px gap; 48px Indigo Wash circle with a 22px Indigo Ink file icon; 17px 600 heading 'No Statements cover <period> yet'; muted sentence max 52ch '<Account> is tracked from <date>. Before that there are no numbers, not zeros.'; Coverage timeline; muted 13px legend; actions centred, 8px gap: primary 'Go to <first tracked period>', bordered 'Show all Members' only when filters narrow, ghost 'Import an earlier Statement'
completeness.timeline: grid, max 760px: Account column (Ink 13px 500, ellipsis; max 120px on phones) then one column per month, Household's first Coverage month to the running month, 2px column gap; month labels muted 11px, Jan and the first with the year; tracked stretch a 14px Muted pill, untracked a 2px Line Strong dash; shown period's columns Indigo Wash with an Indigo Ink 600 label; on phones only quarter and shown labels; no Category hue (Coverage isn't data); aria-hidden, read out by a screen-reader list
completeness.defaults: last full month for every view; Category trends = 12 months ending with it; running month only via next
completeness.reserved: no hatch or dash: those mean Awaiting review

reviewQueue.source: docs/design/review-queue.md; built in templates/ledger/_review.html, the Review queue section of static/pursegraph.css, static/review.js
reviewQueue.groups: Transactions in the queue with one exact description form a group, across Accounts, decided together; a unique description is a group of one; newest first, by latest date
reviewQueue.summary: under the h1, muted 14px: '19 Transactions in 8 groups still need an outcome' ('Nothing left to review.' at zero); it, the sidebar badge and <title> 'Review queue (19)' are swapped in with every change
reviewQueue.layout: master–detail pair of cards, 16px apart, aligned to the top: the list 380px (no padding, clipped), the detail the rest (20px padding, 20px between its parts); the list alone, full width, when nothing is listed
reviewQueue.list: head row 12px muted 'N waiting' and an Ink 2 13px 500 'Show resolved (n)' checkbox, off by default; each group a full-width button on a Line hairline, 10px 16px: description 500 (ellipsis) with a muted 400 '×3', total right 600 tabular, then a muted 12px caption with a dot: '<Category> › <Subcategory> · 78 % sure' (the hue dot), 'No suggestion' (the hatched Awaiting dot) or 'Transfer · other side unknown' (the Transfer ring); Raised hover; the open group Indigo Wash with a 3px Indigo inset at its left edge, aria-current; with Show resolved on, decided groups stay in place, description and total muted, a 14px Ink 2 check and the outcome in the caption
reviewQueue.detail: head: h2 description 18px 600, a muted 13px 'counterparty · Money out | Money in | Bank fee', total right 22px 600 at -0.01em; '3 Transactions with this description' (13px 600) over a mini table on Line hairlines (date Ink 2 7rem, Account pill, amount right); 'Last time': the outcome label, then right-aligned muted 12px 'date · source · 4×', a muted 12px note 'The suggestion differs from what was used last time.' or 'First time this description is seen.'
reviewQueue.decide: a bordered box on the card fill: 1px Line, 8px radius, 16px padding, 12px gap. With a suggestion: muted 12px 500 'Suggested · 78 % sure', the outcome label, one primary 'Accept' / 'Accept for all 3' (reads 'Accepting…' when slow); a Line hairline and 12px, then 'Or choose another outcome' (13px 600) over the chips, already open. Without one: 'Choose an outcome' / '… for all 3'. Chip steps: 'Used last time' (only when it differs from the suggestion), 'Most used' (the suggestion left out), 'Category' (hue dot chips, then Transfer) in the Chip Panel's chip style; a Category chip shows its Subcategories in place, headed by '‹ All Categories' and its dot and name. Ambiguous Transfer: 'Which is the other side of this Transfer?' over candidate cards (8px radius, min 288px: description 500, muted 12px 'date · Account', amount 600 right), then 'Or something else' and the chips ending in 'Transfer, one-sided'. No 'Something else' button and no native select here, on touch too. Without JS every Subcategory step is listed and Category chips hide
reviewQueue.saved: the group is saved whole and the detail stays on it: the outcome label with its muted 12px source caption; a muted 13px line '✓ Saved all 3 as <outcome> · Undo · Make a Rule for "<description>" · See them in Transactions' (Make a Rule only for a hand-picked, unpaired outcome; See them only for a group of more than one, opening Transactions filtered 'Decided just now · 3'); then a primary 'Next: <description> ›', or 'Queue clear · See September on the Dashboard' ('Queue clear · See October so far' when no month completed)
reviewQueue.failed: the Transaction row's failed line inside the decide box, 13px: Ink 500, alert icon, never red, 'Couldn't save <outcome>. Nothing changed.' with Try again (Undo: 'Couldn't undo. Nothing changed.'); the box is kept as it was; announced
reviewQueue.announce: every save, Undo and failure, politely: 'Saved 3 × Bolt.eu as Transport › Public transport & car sharing. 9 left to review.' · 'Undone. Bolt.eu is back in the Review queue.'
reviewQueue.focus: every control swaps #review whole and the response marks what takes focus with data-focus (swap.js; ignored on a page change): opening a group or Undo, its h2; a save, the Next button; '‹ All groups', the open group's button in the list
reviewQueue.queueClear: the detail becomes a centred end state, 32px 16px padding, 12px gap: 48px Indigo Wash circle with a 24px Indigo Ink check; 'Queue clear' 20px 600; muted sentence max 46ch 'Every Transaction has an outcome, 15 of them decided just now. September 2026 is now complete.' (each clause only when true); actions centred, 8px gap: primary 'See September on the Dashboard' and bordered 'October so far' (primary when no month completed)
reviewQueue.noBulk: no queue-wide bulk accept; bulk is per group only
reviewQueue.keyboard: no shortcuts; groups and chips are real buttons in tab order
reviewQueue.phone: ≤900px: the list and the detail are two views; an open group goes full width with a 44px '‹ All groups' text link at the top; group rows 12px 16px; detail padding 16px, decide box 12px; chips, candidate cards and actions 44px, Accept and Next full width, candidate cards full width

transactionsPage.source: docs/design/transactions-page.md; built in templates/ledger/_transactions.html, templates/ledger/_facets.html, templates/ledger/_facet_swap.html, the Transactions page section of static/pursegraph.css, static/transactions.js
transactionsPage.purpose: every Transaction, narrowed by facets, 25 a page, newest first; answers 'find that one' and 'show me all of these'; the Dashboard links into it
transactionsPage.crumbs: only on a link from the Dashboard, above the h1, Ink 2 13px: 'Dashboard › Spending · Food · September 2026', the Dashboard part a 500 link back with the same period and filters, the › Faint; gone once the period, Member or Outcome changes
transactionsPage.search: under the h1, a 300px search field with a Muted search icon inside at the left, 'Search descriptions'; applies as you type, 300ms debounce
transactionsPage.summary: muted line under the search, 16px above the grid: '**142 Transactions** · 1.234,50 € out · 2.410,00 € in' (count Ink 600 tabular; out and in leave Transfers aside); with filters set, Ink 2 '· September 2026, Food › Groceries' and a 500 'Clear filters' text link; the Review queue's arrival names 'Decided just now · 3'
transactionsPage.layout: grid, 252px rail card beside the table card, 16px gap, aligned to the top; the rail sticks 16px from the top and scrolls on its own, max 100vh − 32px
transactionsPage.rail: card, 4px 8px 16px padding; facets 12px apart: Period (All time, months newest first, the running one '(so far)'), Member (Everyone, Members, then Joint), Account (All Accounts, each Account), Outcome (Any outcome, Awaiting review with the hatched dot, Transfer with the ring, each Category with its hue dot; a chosen Category opens its Subcategories), Decided (Any way, by Rule, by LLM, by IBAN, paired, by hand, each with a one-line muted 12px explanation), Amount; each heading muted 12px 500 with a 500 'Clear' text button right while set
transactionsPage.facetOption: full-width button, 6px 8px, 6px radius, Ink 2 14px, the dot then the label, its count right muted 12px tabular (what it would give with every other facet held); Hover fill; chosen Indigo Wash with Indigo Ink 500 and aria-pressed; count 0 faded to 45% but pickable; a Subcategory indented 26px at 13px; one choice per group, picking the chosen again clears it (a Subcategory goes back to its Category)
transactionsPage.amount: a Money segmented control on the theme switch's track (Ground, 3px padding, 8px radius; checked segment Card with the card shadow): Any / Out / In, then muted 12px 500 'Amount between' over two inputs with a muted 'and'; a pick applies, typing after 500ms
transactionsPage.applying: every pick swaps #results with the crumbs, summary, rail, search carry and Filter count out of band and pushes the URL; paging resets to 1; focus stays on the control used, found again by its id; what is typed in an amount field survives an earlier swap (transactions.js); a Transaction changed with Change stays until the filters change
transactionsPage.table: the table card has no padding, clipped; Transaction rows with the Date column, first and last cells 16px in; the source caption's title is the specific reason ('Matched the Rule “HOFER” → Food › Groceries', 'Maja chose it on 8 Oct')
transactionsPage.pager: at the card's foot over a Line hairline, 12px 16px: '‹ Newer' 36px button, page numbers (first, last, current ±1, '…' Muted between; 34px, 8px radius, Ink 2 500 tabular, Hover fill; current Indigo Wash with Indigo Ink and aria-current), '26–50 of 192' muted 13px, 'Older ›'; the ends at 35% when disabled; keeps the filters and scrolls to the grid's top
transactionsPage.deepLinks: period, member, account (the Dashboard's own), q, outcome (unresolved, transfer, category-<id>, subcategory-<id>), source, dir, min, max, page
transactionsPage.empty: no match: centred, 32px 20px, Ink 600 'No Transactions match.' over a 500 'Clear the filters' link; no Transactions at all: 'Import your first Statement'
transactionsPage.phone: ≤900px: the search and a 'Filter' button (filter icon, active-filter count badge) stick to the top, 44px, on the 92% Ground tint with a 10px backdrop blur; the rail becomes the Filter sheet, a popover like More: 18px top corners, a 36×4px Line Strong grip, max 90vh, scrolling, sheet-up .25s, 35% black backdrop; head 'Filter' 17px with a 44px 'Clear all' right, focus on it as it opens; options 10px 8px at 15px (Subcategories 14px), segments 38px, amount inputs 44px; a sticky foot over a hairline with a full-width 44px primary 'Show 142 Transactions' that closes it; picks apply live underneath; the pager centres with 40px page buttons and no range

importBoard.source: docs/design/import.md; built in templates/ledger/import.html, templates/ledger/_import.html, the Import section of static/pursegraph.css, static/import.js, the question, equals and arrow icons in templates/_icons.html; copy in ledger/importer.py, ledger/import_results.py, ledger/board.py
importBoard.purpose: Statements dropped anywhere on the page land on the row of the Account they went into; every Account on one shared time axis, so its Coverage and Gaps read at a glance
importBoard.header: page-head row, 12px gap, 12px below: h1 'Import' (24px, tabindex -1) and, with JS only, the primary 'Choose files' with the upload icon, which opens the file input
importBoard.dropStrip: slim card under the header, 16px below, 12px 16px padding, a 1.5px dashed Line Strong border and no shadow: a 20px upload icon, Ink 2 600 'Drop Statements anywhere on this page.' then Muted 'PDF Statements from Sparkasse SI, N26 and Revolut, and Revolut CSV exports. Several at once.', 12px gap; the whole page is the drop target, and files dragged over it turn the strip Indigo-bordered on Indigo Wash with Indigo Ink text; a drop stages them and focuses the submit
importBoard.staging: once files are chosen the idle line gives way to one row per file: grid 16px file icon | name (Ink 2 500, ellipsis) | 80px size (Muted 13px tabular, right, '240 kB', '1,2 MB') | 112px state (Muted 13px 'Ready') | 36px ghost × ('Remove <name>'), 12px gap, min 44px, Line hairlines; a re-dropped file (same name and size) is not added twice; then the foot, 12px above: Muted 13px 'Each file lands on its Account's row below.', a bordered 'Cancel' (clears, focus back to Choose files) and the primary 'Import 1 file' / 'Import 7 files'
importBoard.progress: one POST for the batch; while it runs the staged foot and the × buttons hide; a line over a Line hairline (4px 0 12px): Muted 13px with the Ink 600 label 'Uploading 7 files' and the percentage right ('42 %'), over a 6px pill bar on Ground with an Indigo fill (role=progressbar, aria-valuenow, .2s linear); at 100% it turns indeterminate, a 30% Indigo segment sweeping over 1.1s, labelled 'Checking and importing 7 Statements · oldest first, so each one's Duplicates are found', and each row's state becomes a 14px spinner (2px Line Strong ring, Indigo top, .8s turn); a failed request puts the files back as staged
importBoard.announce: politely, via the announce event: 'Uploading 7 files' at the start, 'Uploaded. Checking and importing them, oldest first.' at the upload's end; the swapped-in result's headline is focused and announced (swap.js)
importBoard.banner: card, 16px 20px padding, 16px gap, 16px below: a 22px Indigo Ink check icon (info when nothing was imported), the 15px 600 headline '173 Transactions imported from 3 files' or 'Nothing imported' (tabindex -1, focused), under it a Muted line of what waits, joined by ' · ': '44 wait for review · 1 file needs an Account · 2 files weren't imported · 1 was already imported'; at the right, only when something waits for review, the primary 'Review now' with the arrow icon, to the Review queue
importBoard.tray: card with no padding, 16px below: h2 15px 'Needs you · 3 files' (20px 20px 8px), then one item per file over a Line hairline: grid 170px | rest, 20px gap, 16px 20px padding; the left column a status word over the file name (Ink 2 13px 500, breaks anywhere), 4px apart; the right the Choose-the-Account form or the rejection; files needing an Account come first
importBoard.statusWords: a 16px icon and a 600 13px word, both Ink, 6px apart: 'Needs an Account' (question), 'Not imported' (alert), 'Already imported' (equals, in Muted 500 on its line); the icon carries the difference, never a red, green or Category hue (the No Verdict Rule)
importBoard.rejection: h3 15px heading names the cause ('A payment seems to be missing', 'Not a Statement Pursegraph can read', 'Not a PDF or CSV file', 'Doesn't follow on from what's imported', 'Disagrees with what's already imported', 'Wrong bank for that Account', 'This Statement belongs to <Account>', '<Account> takes no Statements'); then the message in Ink 2 (max 70ch) and the next step in Ink ('Keep the file: the N26 reader needs a fix. Until then, <Account> has a Gap for <period>.'); the evidence behind 13px Indigo Ink summaries, 8px above ('Show the reconciliation', 'Show the balances', 'Show the day that differs' / 'Show the 3 days that differ', 'What the reader found', nested 'All 30 rows read'), each a Raised box with a Line border, 8px radius, 16px padding: label/figure pairs (Muted labels, 500 figures right, 4px 24px gaps) and 13px tables; the figure that disagrees is 700 with a 2px Ink underline 4px below, never a colour
importBoard.chooseAccount: h3 'Choose the Account'; with an IBAN 'A Statement from N26, 1–30 Sep 2026. Its IBAN DE89 … isn't on any Account yet. Pick the Account it belongs to, or create one. The IBAN is added to it, so next time the Statement goes there by itself.', without 'A Revolut CSV export, 1 Jan – 14 Oct 2026. It carries no IBAN, so pick the Account it belongs to, or create one.'; the bank's Accounts as radio rows (min 40px, 8px 12px, 10px gap, Line Strong border, 8px radius, Card, 14px; name then Muted '· owners'; Hover fill; checked an Indigo border with a 1px inset Indigo ring; focus ring on the row), then 'A new N26 Account', which reveals Name and Owners checkboxes in two columns indented 28px (CSS :has, no JS); primary 'Import into this Account'
importBoard.alreadyImported: not a failure and not in the tray: one Muted line under it per file, 16px below, the status word then 'sparkasse_2026-08.pdf went into Maja's Sparkasse on 3 Sep 2026; nothing changed.'
importBoard.board: one card, no padding, clipped; a visually hidden h2 'Accounts and their Coverage'; the head and each row a grid of a 250px who column and the track, 20px gap, 0 20px padding; with no Accounts, Muted 'No Accounts yet. An import makes the first one.' padded 20px
importBoard.axis: the head row (16px top, 8px bottom, Line hairline, aria-hidden), Muted 12px 500: 'Account' over the who column, then an 18px axis from the Household's first Coverage day to today: quarter months ('Apr', 'Jul', 'Oct') centred on their tick, and at January the year ('2026') in Ink 2 600, starting at its tick
importBoard.row: 16px top and bottom, aligned to the top, Line hairline between rows; who: the Account name 14px 600 (breaks anywhere), Muted 13px 'bank · owners' (Member names), then 4px below, 4px 12px apart, the 500 Indigo Ink link buttons '20 Statements' (a disclosure) and, for admins, 'Edit' (to the Account's edit page)
importBoard.track: 30px high, 2px below the row's top; a 1px Line hairline at every quarter tick through the track; stretches 22px high, 4px from the top, 5px radius: covered in Coverage Slate, the stretch this import added in Indigo as a state, not a series (the One Indigo Rule); today a 1.5px Ink rule at the right end, 4px over the track above and below; the drawn stretches are aria-hidden
importBoard.gaps: each Gap an outlined slot button: Card fill, 1.5px Ink 2 border, no shadow, min 8px wide, Hover fill; an Ink 11px 600 tabular label, shown only when the slot is wider than 2.2% of the axis: the months when the Gap is whole months ('Jul', 'Jul–Aug'), else its length ('49 d'), always the length for the Gap since the last Statement; aria-label 'Gap 1–31 Jul 2026: import a Statement' or 'Gap 1 Sep – 19 Oct 2026, since the last Statement: import a Statement'; never hatched (the hatch is Awaiting review's) and never a hue
importBoard.caption: under the track, 6px below, Muted 13px, wrapping with 4px 16px gaps: the result as an Indigo Ink 600 disclosure 'New: 1–30 Sep 2026 · 64 Transactions, 20 to review', each Gap in text ('Gap 1–31 Jul 2026', 'Gap 1 Sep – 19 Oct 2026, since the last Statement'), 'Tracked from 1 Jan 2025'; a visually hidden ordered list reads the timeline ('Covered …', 'Covered by this import …', 'Gap …'); in place of a track 'Takes no Statements: money moved to its IBAN counts as a Transfer.' or 'No Statements yet.'
importBoard.counts: the result disclosure opens under the row, full width, 8px above: a Raised list, 8px radius, 12px 16px padding, 4px apart; each a 44px right-aligned Ink 600 tabular figure and Ink 2 text, 8px gap: '64 Transactions imported', '22 Duplicates skipped: already imported from an earlier Statement', '4 card payments still pending or declined, left out', '3 Transfers recognised: 2 paired, 1 one-sided', '1 categorized Transaction is now a Transfer', '1 Transfer has several possible other sides, so it waits in the Review queue', '41 categorized by Rules', '20 wait for suggestions and review · Review queue' (a link); zero counts read 'No Duplicates', 'No Transfers', 'None categorized by Rules' in Muted 500
importBoard.statements: '20 Statements' opens a table under the row, full width, on Raised with an 8px radius, cells 8px 12px, newest first: Period, Format, Transactions (right, tabular), Imported ('3 Sep 2026, Maja'), and a Delete link for admins and for the Member who imported it (to the confirming delete page)
importBoard.gapAction: activating a Gap shows a notice above the drop strip (Indigo Wash, Indigo Ink 500, 8px radius, 8px 8px 8px 16px, an 18px file icon, role=status): 'For Luka's N26: a Statement covering 1–31 Jul 2026. Download it from N26 and drop it here.', with a ghost × 'Dismiss'; focus goes to Choose files, also on dismiss; the Account isn't preselected, the Statement's IBAN decides it
importBoard.noJs: the strip is a plain multipart form: the drop line and Choose files hide, a labelled <input type=file multiple> with a primary 'Import' posts as a page; the Choose-the-Account forms post too; disclosures show open; with JS HTMX posts and swaps #import alone
importBoard.phone: ≤900px: the board's head drops 'Account' and rows stack (who over track, 8px gap), 16px side padding; Gap labels hide, the caption names them; tray items stack (8px gap, 16px padding); the banner wraps with 'Review now' full width; staged rows drop the size, the staged foot wraps with its note on its own line; the new-Account fields go to one column, unindented

components.name: Button
components.description: The default quiet, bordered control: filters, period unit, Account picker, Cancel. Never filled with indigo.

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink, #111827); background: var(--card, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #d1d5db); box-shadow: var(--shadow-ctl, 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / .04)); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, #f3f4f6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn .ds-icon { color: var(--muted, #656c79); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; background: var(--card, #ffffff); } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

A head with the description as an 18px 600 h2, a muted 13px 'counterparty · Money out', and the total right at 22px 600; '3 Transactions with this description' (13px 600) over a mini table on Line hairlines (date in Ink 2, the Account pill, the amount right); 'Last time' with the outcome label and a right-aligned muted 12px 'date · source · 4×', or the muted note 'First time this description is seen.'. Then the decide box, bordered on the card fill (1px Line, 8px radius, 16px padding): muted 12px 500 'Suggested · 78 % sure', the outcome label, one primary 'Accept for all 3'; a Line hairline, 'Or choose another outcome' (13px 600) and the chip steps (Used last time, Most used, Category with Transfer) in the Chip Panel's chip style, already open. Once saved the box holds the outcome with its source, a muted 13px '✓ Saved all 3 as … · Undo · Make a Rule for "…" · See them in Transactions' and a primary 'Next: <description> ›'. A failed save is the Transaction row's Ink 500 line inside the box. On phones a 44px '‹ All groups' link heads it, the padding is 16px (12px in the box), chips are 44px and Accept and Next stretch full width. The snippet shows the box before a save.

narrative.overview:
Pursegraph deliberately looks like a polished personal-finance dashboard: a light sidebar, white cards on a cool grey ground, stat tiles, a Category donut and a single indigo accent. Monarch Money's craft is the bar. The convention is the point, because familiarity serves the least technical Member reading the Dashboard on a phone. Nothing quirky is smuggled in. Distinction comes from execution: exact figures, steady Category hues, quiet type and soft lift.

The density is calm, not terminal-like. A view shows a few large figures, one chart and one ranked list, and detail opens on request (drill-down) rather than up front. Copy and colour describe and never judge. A comparison reads "523,55 € less than September" in muted grey, with no red or green verdict. Dark mode is the same world at night: a near-black ground, raised graphite cards, and the same Category hues lifted in lightness so they keep their identity.

The real app is server-rendered Django templates with HTMX, hand-written CSS custom properties and no build step. ECharts draws the charts. Every asset is self-hosted, including Inter as an OFL variable woff2 under `static/fonts/`, because the app runs offline from the internet on the LAN or a VPN.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey ground, white 14px cards with soft ambient shadow, one indigo accent used only for chrome.
Inter throughout, with tabular figures on every amount, and sl-SI number formatting ("1.234,56 €").
Ten Category hues (Tableau-10-derived), keyed by Category id and identical in every view, with a lifted set for dark.
Charts that never rely on colour alone: directly labelled donut segments, and a hatch for Awaiting review.
1.5px stroke icons, sentence-case labels, no uppercase tracking.
Light, System and Dark themes, with the system as the default.

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo belongs to the interface: active state, count badge, links, focus, the wordmark and the mark. It is never a data colour, never a chart series and never a Category. On the Accounts board, the stretch the import just added is Indigo as a state ("this import", like the active nav item), not as a series.

rules.name: The Fixed Hue Rule
rules.body: A Category wears the same hue in every view, chart and theme step (lifted in dark, never re-assigned). Hues are keyed by Category id, never by sort order.

rules.name: The Neutral Wait Rule
rules.body: Awaiting review is neutral grey plus a 45° hatch, everywhere it appears (dot, bar and donut segment). It never borrows a Category hue.

rules.name: The No Verdict Rule
rules.body: No red/green good/bad colouring. Comparisons are muted text that describes the difference, and Net is plain ink with its sign. A Category hue that happens to be red or green (cat-8, cat-1) carries no meaning beyond its Category.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every amount, share, count and date figure uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Locale Figure Rule
rules.body: Amounts format with `Intl.NumberFormat('sl-SI', { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR', useGrouping: 'always' })`, giving "1.234,56 €". Shares are whole percent with a space ("26 %"). Net carries an explicit sign.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth is diffuse and ambient, never a hard offset. Cards are borderless in light. Hairlines divide content inside cards, not cards from the ground.

dos: **Do** key every Category's hue to its Category id (`cat-((id − 1) mod 10)`), and use the same hue in every view and chart.
**Do** label donut segments directly and hatch Awaiting review, so no chart relies on colour alone.
**Do** set every figure in tabular numerals and format amounts as sl-SI EUR with grouping always on ("1.234,56 €").
**Do** write comparisons as neutral muted sentences ("523,55 € less than September").

**Do** define every colour as a CSS custom property, with a `[data-theme="dark"]` block and a `prefers-color-scheme` block for `data-theme="system"`, and rebuild chart options from those properties when the theme changes.

**Do** set CSS `color-scheme` per theme, so native controls and scrollbars match, and ship `media`-scoped `<meta name="theme-color">` tags for the ground colour, rewritten by JS when the choice is Light or Dark.
**Do** self-host every asset, including Inter (variable woff2 under `static/fonts/`) and ECharts.
**Do** show each facet option's count with the other facets held, so a Member sees where a pick leads before making it.
**Do** commit an outcome only on a deliberate choice (Accept, a chip, a confirmed OS pick), always name it "Category › Subcategory", and offer Undo after every save.
**Do** show a Rule's effect before it is saved: the Transactions it matches, Now → After, and the count on its Save button.

**Do** turn motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The donut sweep, the chart entrance, chevron rotation, the More and Filter sheets' slide up (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) and the loading line are the whole motion vocabulary. Swaps themselves are instant.
**Do** follow the Swap feedback convention on every HTMX swap: focus by kind of swap, one polite announcement of the new state, and a `<title>` from the partial.
**Do** give every empty page its reason and the action that fills it.
**Do** replace an action that can't run with its reason, and confirm a destructive one inline, naming what it moves or keeps.
donts: **Don't** save on a `<select>`'s `change` where a keyboard can reach it: Chromium and Firefox fire it on every arrow key.
**Don't** use the indigo accent as a data colour, a chart series or a Category hue.
**Don't** give Awaiting review a Category hue, or show it without its hatch.
**Don't** draw a month without Coverage as 0, or compare a figure with an incomplete month without saying so.
**Don't** offer a page before it can have content (setup mode), or show example figures as if they were the Household's.
**Don't** blank a region while it loads, or show a loading state for a swap that finishes within 300 ms.
**Don't** stripe or hatch a Coverage Gap. The hatch is Awaiting review's; a Gap is an outlined slot with its dates in text.
**Don't** write an import rejection for the developer. Lead with the cause and the next step, and keep the reconciliation behind a disclosure.
**Don't** colour spending, Net or comparisons red or green to mean good or bad.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked labels, kickers or eyebrows above titles. Labels are sentence case.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or borders around cards. Lift is soft and ambient.
**Don't** load fonts, scripts or styles from a CDN in production.
